newsitem.title: USA: US Prudential names Michael Shea research director.
newsitem.headline: US Prudential names Michael Shea research director.

text.p: Prudential Securities Inc said Tuesday it named Michael Shea director of equity research.
The firm also said its chief investment strategist, Greg Ip, would take on the additional post of investment policy committee chairman.
Shea, who most recently was the director of institutional equity sales, replaces Michael Culp who has joined PaineWebber Inc as research director.
Timothy Landers, in turn, will replace Shea as institutional equity sales director, the firm said.
